For IIT Madras BS Degree program assignments, including any course or OPPE, the Honour Code says students are expected to produce original work based on individual understanding, and using LLMs such as ChatGPT or Gemini to generate any portion of code is considered plagiarism.
The IIT Madras BS Degree Honour Code says use of LLMs without explicit permission is a violation of the honour code.

The IIT Madras BS Degree Honour Code applies to participation in the IIT Madras BS Degree program and says participants must agree to the Honour Code and any additional course- or program-specific terms posted on study.iitm.ac.in/ds.

For IIT Madras BS Degree Honour Code violations, the page says actions may include zero or no credit, withholding or revocation of a certificate or degree, unenrollment, termination of site use, additional action at IIT Madras' discretion, and no refunds.
